title: Floods: Number of evacuees up in Selangor, down in Perak - The Edge Malaysia
text:
Floods: Number of evacuees up in Selangor, down in Perak Wednesday 11 Nov 2026 BURSA SGX Home 
 Make The Edge Malaysia your preferred source on Google KUALA LUMPUR (Nov 11): The number of flood evacuees taking shelter at temporary relief centres (PPS) in Selangor continued to rise, while Perak recorded a decrease, as of 4pm on Wednesday.
 In Selangor, the number of flood evacuees at five PPS in Kuala Selangor increased to 1,032 people, from 289 families, compared with 945 people from 265 families in the morning.
 According to the Social Welfare Department's InfoBencana portal, Sekolah Kebangsaan (SK) Dato’ Maharaja Lela housed the highest number of evacuees at 416, followed by Sekolah Rendah Agama Bukit Kuching (287), SK Parit Mahang (238), Sekolah Agama Batu 8 Ijok (77) and SK Jaya Setia (12).
 In Perak, the number of flood evacuees in the Hilir Perak district decreased to 330 people, from 94 families, compared with 380 people, from 108 families, in the morning.
 The State Disaster Management Committee Secretariat said that Dewan Rumah Rehat Majlis Perbandaran Teluk Intan (MPTI) housed 257 evacuees, while Dewan MPTI Langkap accommodated 73.
 The Malaysian Meteorological Department (MetMalaysia) forecast rain and thunderstorms in all districts of Perak in the afternoon and evening.
